items.label: House Warming Gifts New Home
items.value: As a housewarming gift, this bronze wind chime symbolizes the beginning of a new life chapter, it's a good choice to express congratulations and blessings. In addition, the blessing text printed on the wind chime pendant makes this new homeowner gift more special and meaningful.

items.label: New Home Gifts Ready to Give
items.value: Each new home gift ideas is safely packaged in a premium gift box, tubes are protected with wrapping paper. In addition, we also offers an kraft envelope with a card inside to write your personal blessings. Ideal for women, men, new homeowners, neighbors, couples, family and friends.

items.label: Classic Retro Decoration
items.value: The exquisite bronze wind chime has a unique retro feel, combined with modern craftsmanship to create a elegant home decor. This first home gift windchime is 32 inches, perfect for hanging indoors or outdoors, such as garden, patio, backyard, porch, etc.

items.label: Soothing Tones for Relaxation
items.value: Each ideal wind chimes tube is manually tuned by experts for perfect sound. Soothing tones will create an atmosphere that helps calm the mind and relieve stress. An adjustable striker in the middle of the chime allows you to change the tones or switch to silent mode.

items.label: Upgraded Material
items.value: Compared with inferior wooden boards, our unique wind chimes are made of recyclable high-quality aluminum. The 6 thickened aluminum tubes are made using anodizing technology, which is durable, waterproof, and wear-resistant, and can withstand all kinds of bad weather.
